_recipe.title: Style: kinetic manifesto
_recipe.when: Type-only brand statement or teaser: one phrase per beat on black, hard cuts, a struck-out word, a highlighted word, the name last.
beats: Hook: the old belief, with the word that's wrong struck out.
Manifesto: four to six short phrases, one per beat, each filling the frame.
Turn: one quiet line with a highlighter on the key word.
copyTips: Measured on 44 kinetic-type references: median 4.4 s per shot; the fast ones cut every 1-2 s on the beat. Use --pace fast with music that has a clear beat (npm run music snaps cuts to it).
One idea per line, 1-4 words. If a line needs a comma, split it.
Contrast in size beats contrast in colour: tiny line, giant line, tiny line.
Use one mark per scene: *accent*, ==highlight== or ~~strike~~, never two.
Light version: --theme clean (black type on white) reads like the Jitter / Base44 films.
